gloss: to strike down; to attack; to subjugate

definitions.gloss: to strike down; to slay; to defeat in battle
definitions.explanation: To attack and kill or defeat an enemy, especially in a military or historical context. Often implies righteous punishment or vengeance.

definitions.gloss: to subjugate; to launch a campaign against
definitions.explanation: To mount a military expedition to conquer or suppress an enemy force or region.

examples.english: He set out on a journey to take revenge on his enemy.

examples.japanese: {忠臣蔵|ちゅうしんぐら}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{主君|しゅくん}→主君：11712_shukun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仇|かたき}→仇：11476_kataki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{討|う}った{四十七士|しじゅうしちし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧だ。
examples.english: Chushingura is the story of the forty-seven samurai who avenged their lord.

⟦{将軍|しょうぐん}→将軍：12386_shougun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大軍|たいぐん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{率|ひき}いて→率いる：10879_hikiiru⟧{賊|ぞく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{討|う}ち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: The general led a large army to subjugate the bandits.

examples.english: The imperial court appointed a shogun to subjugate the rebellion in the eastern provinces.

notes:
Distinct from the homophones ⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧ (to hit, to strike physically) and ⟦{撃|う}つ→撃つ：12921_utsu⟧ (to shoot). {討|う}つ specifically means to attack and defeat an enemy, often with a connotation of justice or retribution.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{討|う}つ (to strike down the enemy)
- ⟦{仇|かたき}→仇：11476_kataki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{討|う}つ (to take revenge)
- {賊|ぞく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{討|う}つ (to subjugate bandits)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{討伐|とうばつ}→討伐：14202_toubatsu⟧ — subjugation, punitive expedition
- ⟦{仇討|あだう}ち→仇討ち：16240_adauchi⟧ — revenge, vendetta
- ⟦{討論|とうろん}→討論：05100_touron⟧ — debate (different usage of {討|とう})

Primarily used in historical and literary contexts. In modern usage, ⟦{仇|かたき}→仇：11476_kataki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{討|う}つ survives as a set phrase.
